P02-validation.dc.html.title: P02 · Validation, formatting, calculated and read-only (web)

P06-tab-order.dc.html.title: P06 · Tab order and accessible labels (desktop)

p01.text:
P01 Fill & Sign mode
Fill an interactive form in place: fields are DOM overlays on the page, Tab follows the file's order, the Fields tab lists every field with its state.
States: filling (dropdown open), required fields left, submit confirmation (what leaves the device).
Todos: E8e

p02.text:
P02 Validation, formatting, calculated fields
Errors appear on the field and in the Fields tab; calculated totals and read-only fields are marked; scripts lamina skips are reported.
States: invalid date (focused), calculated total, read-only, script report notice.
Todos: E8f

p03.text:
P03 Form data
Import and export values (JSON, XFDF, FDF), reset and flatten, from the Form data menu.
States: menu open, export dialog, flatten confirmation (signature fields never flattened).
Todos: E8g

p04.text:
P04 Phone, field by field
Fill one field at a time: the page zooms to the field, the form bar above the keyboard has Previous, Next and Done.
States: text field focused, choice field as a sheet.
Todos: E8e

p05.text:
P05 Form design mode
Create, place, resize and configure fields; the inspector holds name, accessible label, options, flags, format, validation and calculation.
States: dropdown selected with handles.
Todos: E9c, E9b

p06.text:
P06 Tab order and accessible labels
See and change the order Tab follows (rows, columns, structure, custom) and give every field a label screen readers announce.
States: custom order, field missing a label.
Todos: E9c

p07.text:
P07 Automatic field detection review
On a flat form, lamina suggests fields; nothing is added until the user accepts each one or all on a page.
States: suggestions pending, some accepted, one selected.
Todos: E9d
